episodes.instruction: Grab the wireless mouse with left and right buttons and set it on Cyan mat.
Grab the flat-bottomed mouse and set it on the Black mat.
Pick up the the hand-sized dark gray mouse and set it on the Black mat.
Use the right arm to pick up the dark gray wireless mouse and drop it on Cyan mat.
Pick the dark gray computer mouse with logo and position it on the Green colored mat.
Pick up the the dark gray computer mouse with logo and set it on the Magenta mat.
Grab the flat-bottomed mouse and set it on Black mat.
Pick the dark gray wireless mouse and position it on the Green colored mat.
